# Decision: Use Go for HQ CLI Implementation

- Date: 2026-07-23
- Status: Accepted

## Context

The HQ CLI needs to run on Windows, Linux, and macOS without requiring a language runtime.

## Decision

Implement the HQ CLI in Go, compiling to native binaries for each target platform. Go provides cross-compilation, standard library breadth, and embed support without external dependencies.

## Consequences

- Single binary distribution per platform.
- Standard library covers JSON, crypto, file I/O, and OS interaction.
- Go 1.21+ embed directive enables self-contained schemas and policy.
